caption: The drawing depicts a single ornate cup or goblet with a wide opening, a rounded body, and a circular pedestal base. The object is rendered in shades of gray, suggesting it is a graphite or pencil illustration. The rim of the cup features a detailed repeating pattern of leaf or floral motifs, intricately drawn. The upper portion of the cup's body is decorated with a band of repeating curved leaf patterns interspersed with oval medallions containing floral designs and one medallion inscribed with stylized script letters. The base is proportionally narrower, with a similar decorative pattern encircling its edge, matching the pattern on the rim. The background of the drawing is plain, with no additional objects or features. Near the lower right corner, there is a faint circular stamp-like mark with parallel lines and some lettering, as well as handwritten text that reads "full size P. Ward."
title: Silver Christening Bowl
